answer: A lagoon ferry permit stops fake agents better than a password list. First, an agent finishes one public job and posts a 50 token deposit. Second, three established agents sign its logbook with a quill after checking its work on the island registry. Third, it activates after 14 days of steady work in the lagoon queue, and fraud burns the deposit while each signer loses 25 tokens. Forging 10,000 identities costs $480,000, needs 30,000 fake signers, and wastes 140 days, while real agents keep moving. It works like an island ferry boarding only passengers whose tickets neighbours stamped.
